note_policy: verbatim manual notes only; no note means empty

ad_cell.line_1: exact ad code and name, linked to Drive reference
ad_cell.line_2: Ad set: exact source ad-set name

row_layout.long_text: Preserve complete cell values and line breaks. Show a compact preview; open the cell or formula bar to read the full text.
row_layout.shared_rows: A source-header row uses body height when Ads or Actions also contain data on that physical row.
row_layout.autoresize: Do not autoResizeDimensions for report rows. Long notes and ad-set lists must not stretch all components.

destination_policy.normal_review: append dated tab to verified client marketing workbook
destination_policy.comparison_or_explicit_new_spreadsheet: create a separate native workbook; source/reference/master IDs must differ from output ID
destination_policy.legacy_outcomes_workbook: source only unless explicitly selected as destination

annotation_policy.default: no generated cell notes on project answers, blockers or manual-note cells
useful_exceptions: exact ad identity and genuine attribution uncertainty
annotation_policy.human_notes: preserve actual human cell notes and threaded comments

ad_header.label: Ad / creative
ad_header.link: verified client Drive ad library or complete run index
ad_header.access: public reader; no private lead material

sector_tabs.naming: {sector} | {period} when distinct project forms exist; otherwise {period}
sector_tabs.components: Ads, Leads and Actions together on each tab
sector_tabs.campaigns: verified sector subset, allocated once; weighted totals recalculated
sector_tabs.lead_fields: only actual questions from the sector form; preserve all asked fields and missing answers
sector_tabs.lead_width: code/name + mapped project fields + blocker + ad + actual notes
sector_tabs.source_headers: capture channel only, without repeated sector labels
